issues.text: In the new Grafana rule list, 'Silence notifications' is a dead button: the menu item appears but clicking it does nothing.
issues.zh: 新版 Grafana rule list 的「Silence notifications」是死按鈕：選單會出現、點下去什麼都不會發生

issues.text: The new Grafana rule list lost Pause and Delete: the newly added grafanaPauseAbility / grafanaDeleteAbility are dead code that can never be reached on this path.
issues.zh: 新版 Grafana rule list 失去 Pause 與 Delete：新增的 grafanaPauseAbility / grafanaDeleteAbility 在這條路徑上是取不到的死程式碼

issues.text: The skipToken path isn't neutral: useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined) derives abilities from global Grafana permissions, causing a Duplicate option to leak onto cloud rules.
issues.zh: skipToken 路徑不是中立值：useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined) 會用全域 Grafana 權限推導 ability，讓 cloud rule 冒出 Duplicate

issues.text: After useAllAlertRuleAbilities was rewritten as a wrapper, federated rule groups are no longer treated as immutable, so the old rules table gains an Edit button.
issues.zh: useAllAlertRuleAbilities 改寫成 wrapper 後，federated rule group 不再是 immutable，舊版 rules table 會冒出 Edit 按鈕

issues.text: FilterView's GrafanaRuleListItem is missing a React key, while the other two branches in the same map have one.
issues.zh: FilterView 的 GrafanaRuleListItem 少了 React key，同一個 map 裡另外兩個分支都有

issues.text: The rule link no longer carries returnTo, so clicking into rule details from filtered results can't navigate back to the original list state.
issues.zh: rule 連結不再帶 returnTo，從篩選結果點進 rule 詳情後回不到原本的列表狀態

issues.text: The new test hardcodes 'exactly 4 menu items,' effectively locking in F-002's missing Pause/Delete as expected behavior.
issues.zh: 新測試把「選單剛好 4 項」寫死，等於把 F-002 的 Pause / Delete 消失釘成期望行為

issues.text: The prom-based abilities narrow 'is a Grafana rule' down to 'is a Grafana alerting rule', causing Grafana recording rules to lose Pause / Export / Restore.
issues.zh: prom 版 abilities 把「是不是 Grafana rule」窄化成「是不是 Grafana alerting rule」，Grafana recording rule 因此失去 Pause / Export / Restore

issues.text: A leftover `// duplicate` comment from development remains in useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities.
issues.zh: 開發過程殘留的 `// duplicate` 註解留在 useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities 裡

issues.text: The new file and new tests leave behind an unreachable prop, an unused selector, and redundant type narrowing.
issues.zh: 新檔案與新測試留下取不到的 prop、沒用到的 selector 與重複的型別收窄

issues.text: After removing the Ruler query, three comments and one variable name still describe behavior that no longer exists.
issues.zh: 移除 Ruler 查詢後，三處註解與一個變數名仍在描述已經不存在的行為

issues.text: getRulesPermissions('grafana') uses a string literal instead of the GRAFANA_RULES_SOURCE_NAME constant.
issues.zh: `getRulesPermissions('grafana')` 用字面量而非 GRAFANA_RULES_SOURCE_NAME 常數

issues.text: RequireAtLeastOne looks like it guarantees 'at least one rule is present,' but it doesn't.
issues.zh: `RequireAtLeastOne` 看起來保證了「至少有一個 rule」，實際上沒有

issues.text: GrafanaGroupLoader renders nothing and has no empty state when the query succeeds but groups is empty.
issues.zh: GrafanaGroupLoader 在查詢成功但 groups 為空時不輸出任何內容，也沒有空狀態

issues.text: The actions array is rebuilt on every render, defeating the useMemo in useRulerRuleAbilities / useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities.
issues.zh: 每次 render 都重建 actions 陣列，讓 useRulerRuleAbilities / useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities 的 useMemo 失效

open_questions.text: After removing the Ruler query, the rule's 'Creating' and 'Deleting' transitional states have completely disappeared from the Grafana rule list — is this a deliberate product decision?
open_questions.zh: 移除 Ruler 查詢後，rule 的「Creating」與「Deleting」過渡狀態在 Grafana rule list 完全消失，這是刻意的產品決定嗎？

open_questions.text: getIsProvisioned passes a Rule into isProvisionedPromRule(promRule: PromRuleDTO) — are these two types actually compatible under TypeScript?
open_questions.zh: `getIsProvisioned` 把 `Rule` 傳進 `isProvisionedPromRule(promRule: PromRuleDTO)`，這兩個型別在 TypeScript 下真的互相相容嗎？
